translations.web: “Thus has the Lord done to me in the days in which he looked at me, to take away my reproach among men.”
translations.bsb: “The Lord has done this for me. In these days He has shown me favor and taken away my disgrace among the people.”
translations.kjv: Thus hath the Lord dealt with me in the days wherein he looked on me, to take away my reproach among men.
